Arm B (Derek 2026-10-29: read, then correct in a second pass) on the same pages: the read, then the #7558 correction pass on it; where it gave no correction the page serves the read. Two rows per arm: agy-flash-low counts every drawn page (a filter-cut or failed read is not accepted, the #7517 convention); agy-flash-low-written only the pages the lane writes (delivered and past apply --first-read-only --print-only). A page not written stays scans-only, which is the current route: the decision rule fixed before judging (RULE.md beside the score) is the written row's wrong text <= 4% and P(acc >= 0.8) >= 0.9.
